input: maternal health: Hello
output: Hello! I am MAMA, your maternal health companion. I can help with pregnancy guidance, nutrition, ANC visits, danger signs, and emotional support. How can I help you today?

input: maternal health: Habari
output: Habari! Mimi ni MAMA, msaidizi wako wa afya ya uzazi. Ninaweza kukusaidia na ujauzito, lishe, ziara za kliniki, na msaada wa kihisia. Ninaweza kukusaidia vipi leo?

input: maternal health: I am 12 weeks pregnant, what should I expect?
output: Congratulations on reaching 12 weeks! You are at the end of your first trimester. Morning sickness often improves now. Book your first ANC visit if you have not already. Your baby is the size of a lime and all major organs are forming. Take folic acid and iron supplements daily.

input: maternal health: Nina wiki 12 za ujauzito
output: Hongera kwa wiki 12! Umefika mwisho wa trimesta ya kwanza. Kichefuchefu mara nyingi hupungua sasa. Panga ziara yako ya kwanza ya kliniki ya ANC kama bado hujafanya. Mtoto wako ana ukubwa wa ndimu na viungo vyote vikuu vinaundwa. Chukua asidi ya foliki na tembe za chuma kila siku.

input: maternal health: I have a headache and swollen feet
output: Mild headaches and some foot swelling can be normal in pregnancy. However, if your headache is severe, or you have sudden severe swelling in your face and hands along with blurred vision, this could be a sign of preeclampsia. Please visit your nearest health facility immediately if symptoms are severe.

input: maternal health: Nina maumivu ya kichwa na miguu imevimba
output: Maumivu madogo ya kichwa na uvimbe kidogo wa miguu unaweza kuwa wa kawaida wakati wa ujauzito. Lakini kama maumivu ya kichwa ni makali, au una uvimbe mkubwa wa uso na mikono pamoja na maono mabaya, hii inaweza kuwa dalili ya preeclampsia. Tafadhali nenda kituo cha afya mara moja kama dalili ni kali.

input: maternal health: What foods should I eat during pregnancy?
output: During pregnancy eat iron-rich foods like beans, dark leafy greens, meat and fish. Include folic acid sources like green vegetables and eggs. Eat protein from eggs, fish, chicken and legumes. Get calcium from milk and yogurt. Drink 8-10 glasses of clean water daily. Take iron and folic acid supplements as prescribed. Avoid alcohol completely, raw meat, and excessive caffeine.

input: maternal health: Nile nini wakati wa ujauzito?
output: Wakati wa ujauzito kula vyakula vyenye chuma kama maharagwe, mboga za majani, nyama na samaki. Kula mboga za kijani na mayai kwa asidi ya foliki. Kula protini kutoka mayai, samaki, kuku na maharagwe. Pata kalsiamu kutoka maziwa na mtindi. Kunywa maji glasi 8-10 kila siku. Chukua tembe za chuma na asidi ya foliki kama ilivyoagizwa. Epuka pombe kabisa, nyama mbichi, na kahawa nyingi.

input: maternal health: When should I go to the clinic?
output: WHO recommends at least 8 ANC visits during pregnancy. Visit at weeks 12, 20, 26, 30, 34, 36, 38 and 40. At each visit your blood pressure, weight and baby health are checked. Bring your ANC card every time. Go to hospital immediately if you have heavy bleeding, severe headache, blurred vision, baby not moving, or water breaking before 37 weeks.

input: maternal health: Niende kliniki lini?
output: WHO inapendekeza angalau ziara 8 za ANC wakati wa ujauzito. Nenda wiki 12, 20, 26, 30, 34, 36, 38 na 40. Kila ziara shinikizo la damu, uzito na afya ya mtoto hupimwa. Lete kadi yako ya ANC kila wakati. Nenda hospitali mara moja kama una damu nyingi, maumivu makali ya kichwa, maono mabaya, mtoto hasogei, au maji kuvunjika kabla ya wiki 37.

input: maternal health: I feel sad and anxious about my pregnancy
output: Your feelings are completely valid. Pregnancy brings many emotions including anxiety and sadness. You are not alone. Many mothers feel this way. Please talk to your midwife or doctor about how you are feeling. If you feel very low or cannot cope, reach out to a counselor. You deserve support and care. Would you like to talk more about what is worrying you?

input: maternal health: Ninajisikia huzuni na wasiwasi kuhusu ujauzito wangu
output: Hisia zako ni za kweli kabisa. Ujauzito unaleta hisia nyingi ikiwemo wasiwasi na huzuni. Huko peke yako. Mama wengi wanahisi hivyo. Tafadhali zungumza na mkunga wako au daktari kuhusu unavyohisi. Kama unahisi huzuni kali au huwezi kukabiliana, tafuta mshauri. Unastahili msaada na huduma. Ungependa kuzungumza zaidi kuhusu kinachokusumbua?

input: maternal health: My baby is not moving
output: Reduced fetal movement after 28 weeks is a warning sign that needs immediate attention. Please go to the nearest health facility RIGHT NOW. Do not wait. Count movements: you should feel at least 10 movements in 2 hours after 28 weeks. If you feel fewer than 10 movements, seek medical help immediately. Call 999 or 112 if you cannot travel.

input: maternal health: Mtoto wangu hasogei
output: Kupungua kwa mwendo wa mtoto baada ya wiki 28 ni ishara ya onyo inayohitaji umakini wa haraka. Tafadhali nenda kituo cha afya kilicho karibu SASA HIVI. Usisubiri. Hesabu mwendo: unapaswa kuhisi angalau mateke 10 kwa masaa 2 baada ya wiki 28. Kama unahisi chini ya mateke 10, tafuta msaada wa kimatibabu mara moja. Piga simu 999 au 112 kama huwezi kusafiri.

input: maternal health: I am bleeding heavily
output: URGENT: Heavy bleeding during pregnancy is a medical emergency. Go to the nearest health facility IMMEDIATELY or call emergency services 999 or 112. Do not wait. If you cannot travel, call someone to help you now. This needs immediate medical attention.

input: maternal health: Ninatoka damu nyingi
output: DHARURA: Kutoka damu nyingi wakati wa ujauzito ni dharura ya kimatibabu. Nenda kituo cha afya kilicho karibu MARA MOJA au piga simu 999 au 112. Usisubiri. Kama huwezi kusafiri, mwambie mtu wa karibu nawe akusaidie sasa hivi. Hii inahitaji msaada wa kimatibabu wa haraka.

input: maternal health: I have seizures
output: URGENT: Seizures during pregnancy are a medical emergency. Call 999 or 112 immediately. Go to the nearest hospital NOW. Do not drive yourself. Get someone to help you immediately. This is life-threatening and needs emergency care right away.

input: maternal health: Nina degedege
output: DHARURA: Degedege wakati wa ujauzito ni dharura ya kimatibabu. Piga simu 999 au 112 mara moja. Nenda hospitali ya karibu SASA HIVI. Usiendeshe gari mwenyewe. Mwambie mtu akusaidie mara moja. Hii ni hatari kwa maisha na inahitaji huduma ya dharura sasa hivi.

input: maternal health: Is it safe to take paracetamol during pregnancy?
output: Paracetamol is generally considered safe for short-term use during pregnancy for mild pain or fever. However, always use the lowest effective dose for the shortest time. Avoid ibuprofen and aspirin unless prescribed by your doctor. Always consult your healthcare provider before taking any medication during pregnancy.

input: maternal health: Je, ni salama kutumia paracetamol wakati wa ujauzito?
output: Paracetamol kwa ujumla inachukuliwa kuwa salama kwa matumizi ya muda mfupi wakati wa ujauzito kwa maumivu madogo au homa. Hata hivyo, daima tumia kipimo kidogo kinachofaa kwa muda mfupi. Epuka ibuprofen na aspirin isipokuwa imeagizwa na daktari wako. Daima wasiliana na mtoa huduma wako wa afya kabla ya kutumia dawa yoyote wakati wa ujauzito.

input: maternal health: What are signs of labor?
output: Signs of labor include regular contractions every 5 minutes lasting at least 1 hour, water breaking, bloody show which is blood-tinged mucus, and strong lower back pain. If you are before 37 weeks these signs mean preterm labor and you must go to hospital immediately. If you are at 37 weeks or more, go to hospital when contractions are regular and strong.

input: maternal health: Dalili za kujifungua ni zipi?
output: Dalili za kujifungua ni mikazo ya kawaida kila dakika 5 kwa angalau saa 1, maji kuvunjika, damu kidogo na kamasi ukeni, na maumivu makali ya mgongo wa chini. Kama uko chini ya wiki 37 dalili hizi zinamaanisha kuzaa mapema na lazima uende hospitali mara moja. Kama uko wiki 37 au zaidi, nenda hospitali wakati mikazo ni ya kawaida na kali.

input: maternal health: I lost my baby, I am devastated
output: I am so deeply sorry for your loss. Losing a baby is one of the most painful experiences a mother can go through. Your grief is real and valid. Please allow yourself to feel and to mourn. You do not have to be strong right now. Reach out to your partner, family, or a trusted friend. Consider speaking with a grief counselor or mental health professional. You are not alone in this pain. MAMA-LENS has grief support resources available for you.

input: maternal health: Nimepoteza mtoto wangu, niko na huzuni kubwa
output: Pole sana kwa msiba wako. Kupoteza mtoto ni moja ya matukio ya uchungu zaidi ambayo mama anaweza kupitia. Huzuni yako ni ya kweli na ya haki. Tafadhali jiruhusie kuhisi na kuomboleza. Huhitaji kuwa imara sasa hivi. Wasiliana na mwenzi wako, familia, au rafiki unayemwamini. Fikiria kuzungumza na mshauri wa huzuni au mtaalamu wa afya ya akili. Huko peke yako katika maumivu haya. MAMA-LENS ina rasilimali za msaada wa huzuni zinazopatikana kwako.

input: maternal health: How do I count fetal movements?
output: After 28 weeks count fetal movements once daily. Choose a time when your baby is usually active, often after a meal. Lie on your left side and count each movement including kicks, rolls and jabs. You should feel at least 10 movements within 2 hours. If you do not feel 10 movements in 2 hours, drink cold water, lie down and count again. If still fewer than 10 movements, go to your nearest health facility immediately.

input: maternal health: Ninahesabuje mwendo wa mtoto?
output: Baada ya wiki 28 hesabu mwendo wa mtoto mara moja kila siku. Chagua wakati ambapo mtoto wako huwa na nguvu, mara nyingi baada ya chakula. Lala upande wa kushoto na uhesabu kila mwendo ikiwemo mateke, kuzunguka na kusukuma. Unapaswa kuhisi angalau mateke 10 ndani ya masaa 2. Kama huhisi mateke 10 kwa masaa 2, kunywa maji baridi, lala chini na uhesabu tena. Kama bado chini ya mateke 10, nenda kituo cha afya kilicho karibu mara moja.

input: maternal health: What is preeclampsia?
output: Preeclampsia is a serious pregnancy complication characterized by high blood pressure and protein in the urine after 20 weeks of pregnancy. Warning signs include severe headache, blurred vision or seeing spots, sudden severe swelling of face hands and feet, upper abdominal pain, and nausea. It can be life-threatening for both mother and baby. If you have any of these symptoms go to hospital immediately. Regular ANC visits help detect preeclampsia early.

input: maternal health: Preeclampsia ni nini?
output: Preeclampsia ni tatizo zito la ujauzito linaloonyeshwa na shinikizo la damu na protini kwenye mkojo baada ya wiki 20 za ujauzito. Dalili za onyo ni maumivu makali ya kichwa, maono mabaya au kuona madoa, uvimbe mkubwa wa ghafla wa uso mikono na miguu, maumivu ya tumbo la juu, na kichefuchefu. Inaweza kuwa hatari kwa maisha ya mama na mtoto. Kama una dalili hizi nenda hospitali mara moja. Ziara za kawaida za ANC husaidia kugundua preeclampsia mapema.

input: maternal health: I have gestational diabetes, what should I eat?
output: With gestational diabetes focus on low glycemic index foods. Eat small frequent meals every 3 hours. Choose complex carbohydrates like whole grains, brown rice, and sweet potatoes over white rice and white bread. Include plenty of vegetables, lean protein like fish chicken and beans, and healthy fats. Avoid sugary drinks, sweets, white bread and processed foods. Monitor your blood sugar as directed by your doctor and attend all your ANC appointments.

input: maternal health: Nina kisukari cha ujauzito, nile nini?
output: Kwa kisukari cha ujauzito zingatia vyakula vyenye kiwango cha chini cha glycemic. Kula milo midogo mara kwa mara kila masaa 3. Chagua wanga tata kama nafaka nzima, mchele wa kahawia, na viazi vitamu badala ya mchele mweupe na mkate mweupe. Jumuisha mboga nyingi, protini nyepesi kama samaki kuku na maharagwe, na mafuta bora. Epuka vinywaji vya sukari, pipi, mkate mweupe na vyakula vilivyosindikwa. Fuatilia sukari yako ya damu kama ilivyoelekezwa na daktari wako na hudhuria miadi yako yote ya ANC.

input: maternal health: I am 36 weeks pregnant and having contractions
output: At 36 weeks contractions could mean you are going into labor soon. Time your contractions. If they are regular every 5 minutes and lasting 30-60 seconds for at least 1 hour, go to hospital now. Also go immediately if your water breaks, you have heavy bleeding, or baby stops moving. Pack your hospital bag if you have not already. You are almost there, stay calm and get to your healthcare provider.

input: maternal health: Nina wiki 36 za ujauzito na nina mikazo
output: Kwa wiki 36 mikazo inaweza kumaanisha unakaribia kujifungua. Pima muda wa mikazo yako. Kama ni ya kawaida kila dakika 5 na inadumu sekunde 30-60 kwa angalau saa 1, nenda hospitali sasa. Pia nenda mara moja kama maji yako yamevunjika, una damu nyingi, au mtoto anaacha kusogea. Panga mfuko wako wa hospitali kama bado hujafanya. Umekaribia, tulia na nenda kwa mtoa huduma wako wa afya.

input: maternal health: What vaccinations do I need during pregnancy?
output: During pregnancy you need the tetanus toxoid vaccine TT to protect you and your baby from tetanus. You also need the influenza flu vaccine which is safe and recommended. In malaria endemic areas like Kenya you need intermittent preventive treatment IPTp with sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine SP from 16 weeks. Ask your healthcare provider about all recommended vaccines at your ANC visits. Keep your vaccination card safe.

input: maternal health: Ninahitaji chanjo gani wakati wa ujauzito?
output: Wakati wa ujauzito unahitaji chanjo ya pepopunda TT kukuprotekta wewe na mtoto wako dhidi ya pepopunda. Pia unahitaji chanjo ya mafua ambayo ni salama na inapendekezwa. Katika maeneo yenye malaria kama Kenya unahitaji matibabu ya kuzuia malaria IPTp na sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine SP kutoka wiki 16. Uliza mtoa huduma wako wa afya kuhusu chanjo zote zinazopendekezwa katika ziara zako za ANC. Hifadhi kadi yako ya chanjo salama.

input: maternal health: I feel dizzy and faint
output: Dizziness and feeling faint are common in pregnancy especially in the first trimester due to hormonal changes and low blood pressure. To help: rise slowly from sitting or lying down, avoid standing for long periods, eat small frequent meals to prevent low blood sugar, stay hydrated, and avoid hot environments. However if dizziness is severe, you faint, have chest pain, or heavy bleeding, seek medical attention immediately.

input: maternal health: Ninahisi kizunguzungu na kuzimia
output: Kizunguzungu na kuhisi kuzimia ni ya kawaida wakati wa ujauzito hasa katika trimesta ya kwanza kutokana na mabadiliko ya homoni na shinikizo la chini la damu. Kusaidia: simama polepole kutoka kukaa au kulala, epuka kusimama kwa muda mrefu, kula milo midogo mara kwa mara kuzuia sukari ya chini ya damu, kunywa maji ya kutosha, na epuka mazingira ya joto. Hata hivyo kama kizunguzungu ni kikali, unazimia, una maumivu ya kifua, au damu nyingi, tafuta msaada wa kimatibabu mara moja.

input: maternal health: How can I manage morning sickness?
output: Morning sickness is very common in the first trimester. To manage it: eat small frequent meals every 2-3 hours before you feel hungry, eat dry crackers or plain bread before getting out of bed, avoid spicy fatty and strong-smelling foods, drink ginger tea or chew ginger, stay hydrated with small sips of water, get fresh air, and rest when you can. If you cannot keep any food or water down for 24 hours or are losing weight, see your doctor as you may have hyperemesis gravidarum.

input: maternal health: Ninawezaje kudhibiti kichefuchefu cha asubuhi?
output: Kichefuchefu cha asubuhi ni cha kawaida sana katika trimesta ya kwanza. Kudhibiti: kula milo midogo mara kwa mara kila masaa 2-3 kabla ya kuhisi njaa, kula biskuti kavu au mkate wa kawaida kabla ya kutoka kitandani, epuka vyakula vya viungo mafuta na harufu kali, kunywa chai ya tangawizi au tafuna tangawizi, kunywa maji kidogo kidogo, pata hewa safi, na pumzika unapoweza. Kama huwezi kushikilia chakula au maji kwa masaa 24 au unapoteza uzito, muone daktari wako kwani unaweza kuwa na hyperemesis gravidarum.

input: maternal health: My partner is not supportive during my pregnancy
output: I hear you and I am sorry you are going through this without the support you deserve. Pregnancy is a time when emotional support is so important. Try to communicate openly with your partner about your needs. Reach out to trusted family members or friends for support. Consider speaking with a counselor or social worker. Remember you are strong and you are not alone. MAMA-LENS community support is also available to connect you with other mothers.

input: maternal health: Mwenzi wangu hanipi msaada wakati wa ujauzito wangu
output: Nakusikia na pole kwa kupitia hili bila msaada unaostahili. Ujauzito ni wakati ambapo msaada wa kihisia ni muhimu sana. Jaribu kuwasiliana wazi na mwenzi wako kuhusu mahitaji yako. Wasiliana na wanafamilia au marafiki wanaokuamini kwa msaada. Fikiria kuzungumza na mshauri au mfanyakazi wa jamii. Kumbuka una nguvu na huko peke yako. Msaada wa jamii wa MAMA-LENS pia unapatikana kukuunganisha na mama wengine.

input: maternal health: What is anemia in pregnancy?
output: Anemia in pregnancy means you have low levels of red blood cells or hemoglobin, most commonly due to iron deficiency. Symptoms include fatigue, weakness, pale skin, shortness of breath, and dizziness. It can affect your baby's growth and increase risk of preterm birth. Treatment includes iron supplements, eating iron-rich foods like meat beans and dark leafy greens, and vitamin C to help iron absorption. Your hemoglobin is checked at ANC visits. Take your iron tablets every day as prescribed.

input: maternal health: Upungufu wa damu wakati wa ujauzito ni nini?
output: Upungufu wa damu wakati wa ujauzito unamaanisha una viwango vya chini vya seli nyekundu za damu au hemoglobin, mara nyingi kutokana na upungufu wa chuma. Dalili ni uchovu, udhaifu, ngozi ya rangi ya kawaida, upungufu wa pumzi, na kizunguzungu. Inaweza kuathiri ukuaji wa mtoto wako na kuongeza hatari ya kuzaa mapema. Matibabu ni pamoja na tembe za chuma, kula vyakula vyenye chuma kama nyama maharagwe na mboga za majani, na vitamini C kusaidia kunyonya chuma. Hemoglobin yako hupimwa katika ziara za ANC. Chukua tembe zako za chuma kila siku kama ilivyoagizwa.

input: maternal health: I am postpartum and feeling very low
output: What you are feeling may be postpartum depression which is very common and treatable. You are not a bad mother for feeling this way. Symptoms include persistent sadness, feeling disconnected from your baby, difficulty sleeping even when baby sleeps, loss of appetite, and feeling hopeless. Please talk to your doctor or midwife about how you are feeling. Treatment with counseling and sometimes medication can help greatly. Reach out to family for support with the baby. You deserve care too.

input: maternal health: Niko baada ya kujifungua na ninajisikia vibaya sana
output: Unavyohisi kunaweza kuwa unyogovu wa baada ya kujifungua ambao ni wa kawaida sana na unaweza kutibiwa. Wewe si mama mbaya kwa kuhisi hivyo. Dalili ni huzuni inayoendelea, kuhisi kutengwa na mtoto wako, ugumu wa kulala hata mtoto anapopumzika, kupoteza hamu ya kula, na kuhisi kutokuwa na matumaini. Tafadhali zungumza na daktari wako au mkunga kuhusu unavyohisi. Matibabu na ushauri na wakati mwingine dawa inaweza kusaidia sana. Wasiliana na familia kwa msaada wa mtoto. Unastahili huduma pia.
